owner_decision: Option A approved as one bounded contract/emitter probe on 2026-07-19. No product bytes are authorized before the probe is green and reviewed.
claim_limit: Host contract and emitter/append probe only. It changes no product source or artifact, authorizes no product capacity and makes no device, latency, compatibility or product-link claim.

single_format_rule.immutable_image_language: C2I-v2 for static shelf images, interactive definitions and persistent compiled libraries
single_format_rule.outer_envelope: one-record L65S-v4-direct with split code and C2I-v2 metadata regions
single_format_rule.legacy_l65m_product_policy: The C2 product rejects L65M on device. Source remains portable; v1.1 compiled artifacts require recompilation or an offline migration tool. No L65M emitter or decoder may remain in the C2 product closure.

extension_envelope.build_identity: header build_id_u32 must equal the running product build identity
extension_envelope.record_identity: record bytes 0..3 are the fixed ASCII tag SESS; library names exist only in the generated L65I index and never occupy the one-record session envelope
extension_envelope.identity: catalog CRC32 plus code CRC32, metadata CRC32 and combined image CRC32; host artifact SHA256 binds all bytes
extension_envelope.layout: header, one record, normalized code, C2I-v2 metadata; all checked arithmetic closes exactly and optional C2I alignment is zero
extension_envelope.strictness: Reject L65S-v3, widening-only v4, count other than one, a record identity other than SESS, unknown flags, wrong build identity, CRC mismatch, overlap, truncation or trailing bytes

session_attic_arena.immutability: bytes are never modified after verified staging within a session generation
session_attic_arena.reset_rule: Attic bytes may survive reset, but the new C2D generation starts without extension records; stale bytes have no callable handle
session_attic_arena.identity_rule: C2D image generation, product build identity and combined image CRC bind every callable source

source_kinds.0: product L65S shelf; offsets relative to 0x08100000; source_slot is the immutable shelf record
source_kinds.1: session extension; offsets relative to 0x08400000; source_slot is the append ordinal

c2d_v3.generation_rule: Header, every active image and every active entry carry the same nonzero session generation. A mismatch is rejected before address calculation. Generation wrap requires cold boot.
c2d_v3.root_rule: Membership is derived only from each identity-bound C2I-v2 descriptor stream. Heap values live only in root_values. During append a u16 pending-root high-water extends the collector scan through newly published canonical slots; rollback zeros those slots and clears the high-water. Normal collections scan root_count only.
c2d_v3.unused_rule: Every inactive image, entry, resolution and root byte is zero. Append writes only the next inactive contiguous ranges. Rollback restores the previous header and zeros every touched inactive byte.
c2d_v3.attic_watermark_rule: The committed Attic watermark is not stored independently. It is derived as the maximum metadata_offset + metadata_length across active source-kind-1 image records (zero with none). Publishing C2D header counts therefore publishes reachability and allocation state from one source.

append_protocol: verify the complete one-record L65S-v4-direct envelope, current product build identity and all CRCs
strictly decode C2I-v2 and derive entry, resolution and root counts from metadata
check C2D image, entry, resolution and root capacities plus Attic arena capacity with u32 arithmetic
stage the complete envelope into unpublished align2 Attic space and read back/verify it
reserve the next inactive C2D ranges and zero them
resolve descriptors; publish each heap value to its sole canonical root slot before later allocation while pending-root high-water protects it
journal every export function cell and validate late-bound rules
write the inactive image, entry and resolution records
publish the new C2D header counts as the directory commit marker; the committed Attic watermark is derived from the now-active session image records
publish export cells last; on any failure restore cells in reverse order, restore the old header/watermark and zero all appended C2D ranges
required_probe_fixtures: same emitter implementation produces a static product image and real compiler-derived session image
candidate output contains no L65M magic or legacy patch table
legacy L65M rejected by the C2 extension decoder and C2 extension rejected by the historical L65M decoder
catalog, code, metadata and combined-image CRC mismatch
image, entry, resolution, root and Attic capacity exhaustion
failure at every append publication phase leaves prior C2D bytes and exports identical
GC after every appended heap allocation preserves canonical roots without writeback
reset between Attic staging and C2D header publication leaves no reachable extension
unknown source kind, flag or record width
zero-length entry, overlapping region and trailing extension bytes
product_gate_after_probe: Before the real product substitution link can pass, its source/object closure must contain the C2 emitter/decoder only and must contain no L65M validator, commit, emitter, magic or runtime slice.
